title: An item pushed or dropped
description: What POST /api/v1/items and POST /api/v1/connectors/{name}/drops answer. A retry under the same Idempotency-Key answers the item the first attempt landed.

items.description: Each item the push or drop landed. A drop of an export lands one per entry.

created.description: False where the item was already landed, and this was one more sighting of it.
